description.default: Replace SiYuan's built-in Mermaid 11.16.1 with the official latest Mermaid 12.3.0. Diagrams keep rendering inline in documents through SiYuan's native pipeline, so editing, reload, fold-deferred rendering and error messages all keep working.
description.zh-CN: 用 Mermaid 官方最新版 12.3.0 替换思源内置的 11.16.1。仍走思源原生渲染流程，代码块在文档中直接渲染为图形，编辑、刷新按钮、折叠延迟渲染、语法报错提示行为与原生一致，只是引擎换成了新版。
